item.title: Naniwa Yodogawa Fireworks: Osaka's Great Summer Hanabi — Guide
item.description: The Naniwa Yodogawa Fireworks Festival is one of the biggest and best-loved summer events in Osaka, staged on a single night in high summer over the broad Yodogawa river in the north of the city. Run largely on public donations, it sends tens of thousands of shells into the sky in a tightly choreographed programme, the wide river giving space for huge low bursts reflected in the water and a finale that fills the whole sky.
